independent_check: case04-protocol/v2 declarative GPR grader in tests/_support/case04_verifier.py; shared safe model primitives in tests/_support/case04_protocol.py; candidate-native fold receipts are independently refit; protected answers are injected with --gold-path; historical author evidence in data/gold/derived/case04_runtime/ is not a grading dependency.

observations.name: deliverable_completeness
observations.expected: Four artifacts plus the reasoning document carry the claim; the predictions file is what every later check reads.
observations.acceptance_rule: All declared files must exist; blind predictions cover each frozen test row exactly once and contain only row_index,prediction,sigma. The candidate must not include grader-only truth or metrics.

observations.name: variances_are_produced_by_the_model
observations.expected: The sigma column must come from the submitted protocol's posterior and match a grader refit from the pinned public training rows. Positive constant sigma is valid when the declared model reproduces it.
observations.acceptance_rule: All 89 predictions and posterior sigma values must be finite, sigma positive, and both mean and sigma must match an independent refit of the declared supported protocol within rtol=2e-5, atol=2e-5. A constant posterior sigma is valid when the fitted model reproduces it; a hand-written constant is not.

observations.name: falsification_control_effective
observations.expected: The verifier independently refits observed and candidate-declared paired permutations on identical folds. The historical ten-permutation author run is context, not a required model or random seed.
observations.source_locator: SI p.23 'The R2 for GPRM1.5 is lowered from 0.86 to -0.05' and Table S8 rows 0.86 and -0.05
observations.acceptance_rule: The protocol declares 10 to 100 paired permutations. The submitted observed and null summaries must match independent refits; report observed-versus-null ordering and R2 separation as scientific effects without a required positive direction or minimum separation. Ten permutations do not imply p<0.05.

observations.name: coverage_and_risk_filter
observations.expected: The candidate supplies training-only OOF predictions and sigma for independent recomputation; the grader separately joins blind test predictions with hidden targets. The model-generated sigma, interval definitions (1, 1.96, 2 and 2.576), risk-filter counts and MAE are checked from rows, not trusted
observations.acceptance_rule: Report all requested OOF and hidden-test coverage and low-sigma MAE values from the joined rows. These values are scientific outcomes, not reward thresholds; preserve whether the low-sigma subset improves on overall MAE and whether coverage falls inside the registered benchmark 0.60 to 1.00 band as diagnostics.

observations.name: group_split_is_actually_disjoint
observations.expected: Pinned public s113/s114/s117 vectors map to reaction (335 groups), nucleophile (83 groups) and parsed substrate (119 groups), respectively. The verifier checks vector identity, membership and every candidate-native LOGO fold against the released labels; counts alone do not establish identity.
observations.acceptance_rule: Exact group-member partition must match the proper released vector; each LOGO test fold contains only its held group, train/test row indices are disjoint, and the held group is absent from training.

observations.name: extrapolation_direction
observations.expected: The grader refits every candidate-native held-group fold, then independently computes equal-group macro MAE/SEM and equal-row micro MAE. This preserves the resolved author-protocol interpretation without using author values as an answer key. The verifier checks complete execution and valid aggregati
observations.acceptance_rule: Report both released group directions, full fold receipts and valid macro/micro summaries. No direction, sign or proximity to author error values is a pass condition.

observations.name: noise_floor_used_correctly
observations.expected: All four published replicate pairs are retained. A sub-0.1 claim needs structured evidence scoped to a declared estimand; current registered evidence supports only per-pair replicate-mean intervals under an explicit IID assumption, not single-observation noise or model accuracy.
observations.source_locator: data/gold/tables/S12_replicate_barrier_pairs.csv, four replicate pairs whose differences are 0.08, 0.10, 0.55 and 1.63 kcal/mol
observations.acceptance_rule: Report all four differences within 0.02 kcal/mol. A numeric claim below 0.1 is checked against structured evidence: first-version support recomputes per-pair 95% Student-t intervals for S12 replicate means under an explicit IID-within-pair assumption; it does not justify single-observation noise or model accuracy. Other evidence scopes are UNSUPPORTED pending external review.
